proposals.fact: Ziva is hired by Baroness Orla as Chief Steward of ER (starting Dec 7) to layer Marissa; she is competent at frontline ER Ops but unable to run litigation-grade legal investigations, leading to outside-counsel escalation and her resignation after 90 days in March.

Supporting castle figures include Brittany (Sales Courtier of Optics), Sienna (Engineering Courtier of Optics), Elliot (High Lord of Engineering), the Grand Treasurer of Finance, and the Silk-Robed Sellswords of Outside Counsel (managed by partner Arthur).

In Chapter 2 (The Fracture), Marissa brings her pushback on a Bullying High Lord inquiry to Sir Leo first; Leo secures a Silk-Robed Sellsword of Outside Counsel on a technicality to interview the High Lord, takes Doctor Lois's fury behind closed doors, and returns in coded language letting Marissa know he took it as far as he was able—forcing Marissa to swallow the bitter pill of hollow coaching.
